description: Explicit sense bridge BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE_2 → BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE_3 (strength order): an actually existing external efficient cause of a thing's esse is another being that causes its being (CausesIn c x esse), so the participated has another cause of its being, the root-path statement. With PARTICIPATED-EXTERNAL-ESSE-CAUSE-BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE-2 it gives a route to STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE through sense 2. Sense 1 (cause of becoming) gives no such route: the controls model it with no cause of being.
